description: This file defines the interface and factory for the IMainThread component in the Rialto server module. It includes class declarations for IMainThread and IMainThreadFactory, with methods for client registration, task enqueueing, and thread management.

classes.name: IMainThreadFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create and retrieve instances of IMainThread.

classes.name: IMainThread
classes.description: Interface for main thread operations, including client registration and task management.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates a shared pointer to an IMainThreadFactory instance.

methods.name: getMainThread
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to an IMainThread instance.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client on the main thread and returns its client ID.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client from the main thread using its client ID.

methods.name: enqueueTask
methods.description: Enqueues a task to be executed on the main thread for a specific client.

methods.name: enqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Enqueues a task on the main thread and waits for its completion.
